# HaiLanGo

> HaiLanGo is an AI-powered language learning platform that transforms your existing textbooks into interactive learning experiences. It combines OCR, TTS, STT, and AI technologies to provide personalized 24/7 language instruction, focusing on conversation patterns and vocabulary rather than grammar.

## Core Concept

HaiLanGo enables users to:
- Upload their own language learning books (PDF/images)
- Extract text via OCR with multi-language support
- Listen to native pronunciation via TTS
- Practice speaking with AI-powered pronunciation evaluation
- Learn with spaced repetition (SRS) algorithm
- Use "Teacher Mode" for hands-free audio lessons

## Technology Stack

- Framework: Rust with [Reinhardt](https://github.com/kent8192/reinhardt-web) (Django-inspired full-stack)
- Frontend: Server-side rendered HTML with HTMX/Alpine.js
- Database: PostgreSQL, Redis
- External APIs: Google Vision (OCR), Google/Azure TTS, OpenAI Whisper (STT), Anthropic Claude (LLM)

## Supported Languages

Primary: Japanese, English, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish
Extended: Persian, Hebrew, and any language supported by TTS/STT APIs

## Key Features

1. **Book Digitization**: Upload PDF or images, extract text with OCR
2. **Interactive Learning**: Page-by-page study with audio playback
3. **Teacher Mode**: Automated lesson playback for passive learning (commute, exercise)
4. **Pronunciation Practice**: Real-time feedback with scoring (0-100)
5. **Spaced Repetition**: SM-2 algorithm for optimal review scheduling
6. **Offline Support**: PWA with pre-downloaded audio
